theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U V₁ V₂ G : Set (Euclid P)) (h₁ : U ⊆ V₁) (h₂ : U ⊆ V₂) (Z : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (X : GeometricCurrentOn V₁ n) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn V₂ n) (c : ℝ), (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ G → Z ω = X (testFormOnInclusion h₁ n ω) + c * Y (testFormOnInclusion h₂ n ω)) → Z.massOn G ≤ X.massOn G + ENNReal.ofReal |c| * Y.massOn G
